protocol.audit: initial/every callback/final geometry; static force group readback along fixed heavy outward direction and its HA-sphere tangent; callback gradient vs physical HA force
protocol.enrollment: faithful native H-stage reproduction for ALL24 original H seeds, with reporter added only at the original call boundary; no alternative H placement/seed/strength/iteration search
protocol.invariants: zero constraints/PBC/virtual sites; identical original serialized System, fixed-existing coordinates and final H endpoint required
protocol.limits: callbacks are optimizer iteration observations, not all line-search evaluations, physical dynamics, integrated work, convergence or a production repair
protocol.reporter: read-only copies of native callback coordinates/objective gradients/stats, always return False; preserve ordinal and native iteration separately
protocol.retention: all callbacks privately, failures/timeouts/budget nonexecutions separate, no retry/adoption
